selection_policy: Use available Kalva shortlist for uncovered years; otherwise fall back to actual IMO. Add actual IMO problems when shortlist pages omit used problems.

problems.statement_en: In the interior of △ P1P2P3 a point P is given. Let Q1, Q2, and Q3 respectively be the intersections of PP1, PP2, and PP3 with the opposing edges of △ P1P2P3. Prove that among the ratios PP1/PQ1, PP2/PQ2, and PP3/PQ3 there exists at least one not larger than 2 and at least one not smaller than 2. (DR Germany)
